rationale: The workflow already implements the primary evidence-supported optimizations: (1) Dependency caching via the custom setup action (rust-cache, uv-cache-key, corpus caching) covering P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; (2) Stale run cancellation via concurrency with cancel-in-progress for PRs covering P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE; (3) Path-based trigger filtering in the 'on' section covering P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER. The test matrix explicitly sets fail-fast: false, likely intentionally to collect full cross-platform results (contraindication for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST). Adding custom timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) would require representative duration history to set safe limits with headroom; only 5 historical runs are visible (6-16 min total), which is insufficient to confidently set per-job timeouts without risk of false failures. Other patterns (Bazel, distributed cache, test selection, etc.) are not applicable to this Rust/uv-based workflow or have contraindications. No further evidence-supported optimization with verified prerequisites is identified.
